card.line: Galatia was a region in central Asia Minor where Paul traveled and strengthened the disciples, and where churches received his letter about the true gospel.

moments.title: Paul Travels Through Galatia
moments.text: After the Holy Spirit kept them from speaking the word in Asia, Paul and his companions traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.

moments.title: Strengthening the Disciples
moments.text: After some time in Antioch, Paul went from place to place through Galatia and Phrygia. He strengthened all the disciples there.

moments.title: Turning to a Different Gospel
moments.text: Paul wrote to the churches of Galatia. He was amazed that they were quickly turning to a different gospel, and he warned that no other gospel is the true one.
